groups.rationale: Combined guest-os-matrix review: FreeBSD fault-kernel wrong-CID and racing invalid-reset evidence (chapters 07/19/20) merged with OmniOS Nix KVM assembly plus formal native-omnios-transport/reset gates (chapters 07/17/19); statements checked for consistency, OmniOS wrong-CID/DMA and shutdown-send timeout remain gaps.
